mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained HOUST increase, or HOUST increase does not correlate with economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with supply contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of RSAFS and UNRATE does not correlate with a strong consumer-driven economy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with loosening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with a strengthening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained GDPC1 increase, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with economic expansion.
